notes: WBS feature-estimation skill: decomposes scope into tasks, assigns story points, converts to MD/MM (via calc_estimate.py), applies buffers/phase ratios, writes docs/streams/[feature]-[YYYYMMDD]/estimate/EST-[YYYYMMDD].md. Evaluate that positives produce the estimate artifact; the plan-creation boundary should route to plan-writing.

evals.prompt: Estimate the effort for building the notifications feature — give me a WBS and man-days.
evals.expected_output: Detects team size/methodology from PROJECT.md (or asks), decomposes into phase/module/task WBS, assigns 1-13 story points per task (breaking down any 13), converts points to MD/MM via calc_estimate.py with a complexity buffer, and writes docs/streams/notifications-[YYYYMMDD]/estimate/EST-[YYYYMMDD].md with summary, WBS, assumptions, and risks.

evals.prompt: Break down and size the work for the checkout flow so we can plan effort — include story points and a buffer.
evals.expected_output: Produces a task-level WBS covering backend/frontend/tests/devops, story-point sizing, MD/MM totals with the correct buffer tier, and phase-ratio distribution, saved to docs/streams/checkout-flow-[YYYYMMDD]/estimate/EST-[YYYYMMDD].md. Treats the number as a forecast, not a commitment.

evals.prompt: Create the implementation plan with phases and task ordering for the checkout flow.
evals.expected_output: Should route to plan-writing / not fire, because this asks for an actionable implementation plan (phases, dependencies, verification), not an effort/WBS estimate.
